senses.gloss: , with suff. <he>כַּנּ־</he>, m. (b. h.; <cite ref="K00296"><he>כּוּן</he></cite> or <cite ref="K00859"><he>כָּנַן</he></cite>)

units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:11">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> (ref. to <he>והנה חלום</he>, <cite ref="I Kings 3:15">I Kings III, 15</cite>) <he>החלום … על כַּנּוֹ</he> the dream (after he awoke) remained standing on its firm stand (was realized); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 175:5">Yalk. Kings 175</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 5:3">Yoma V, 3</cite>, sq. <he>הניחו על כ׳ וכ׳</he> he set it down on the stand.

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 2:17">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 17</cite> <he>מחוסרין כן</he> vessels that have lost their rest; a. fr.—Pl. <he>כַּנִּים</he>, constr. <cite ref="K00849"><he>כַּנֵּי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 77b:1">Yeb. 77ᵇ</cite> <he>גיורת מכַּנָּהּ</he> a proselyte of her own status, i.e. born after the conversion of her parents both of whom were of the same nation.

senses.gloss: (cmp. כּוּן Pi.) ruler. Ib. XII, 8; Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. VII, 12 הכן והכַּנָּה (Var. והכַּנָּא) the ruler and that which is ruled (the writing material); oth. opin.: the ruled material and the ruler; [oth. opin.: (cmp. σταθμός) the base of the scales and the scales; oth. opin. the strike and the measure.]
